policy: Use one small decorative icon per meaningful heading or navigation item. Keep its text label. Never decorate individual equations, scientific symbols, controls or every paragraph.

types.usage: Lesson overview and objectives; the title already supplies hierarchy.
Definitions, physical interpretation and theoretical derivations.
Measurements, instrument controls and experimental protocols.
Plots, diagrams, measured values and result summaries; not individual axes.
Named formula collections and formula maps; never inside mathematical expressions.
Problem statements and worked solutions; not each algebraic step.
Quizzes, numerical questions and self-assessment sections.
A collection of definitions; not each individual term.
Editable observations and experiment records; preserve users' text.
Further lessons, references and offline downloads.
Model limits, assumptions and scientific cautions; use quiet borders rather than repeated icons.
Sliders, numerical inputs and playback. Retain their existing functional icons.
